model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбова диаграма илюстрира точността в проценти за пет различни метода – DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection и PPO – при три различни тестови набора: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Хоризонталната ос представлява категориите по тестови набори, разположени отляво надясно в реда Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Вертикалната ос представлява точността в проценти, етикетирана от 50 до 62 с равномерни интервали от 0.2, като скалата е линейна. Всяка категория по хоризонталната ос съдържа пет вертикални стълба, които са групирани и съответстват на петте метода, като всеки метод е представен с уникален цвят и текстура, както е указано в легендата в горния десен ъгъл. Стълбовете са подредени във визуален ред, който съответства на реда на методите в легендата, а не по низходящ ред на височината. Всеки стълб е етикетиран със съответната точност в проценти, като най-високите стълби са около 61% за DAPO+Self-reflection в Physics и около 60% за SRPO в Physics, докато най-ниските стълби са около 52% за DAPO в Mathverse и около 53% за GRPO в Mathverse. Няма визуално подчертани стълби или допълнителни бележки.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该柱状图旨在比较五种不同方法（DAPO+Self-reflection、DAPO、GRPO、PPO+Self-reflection、PPO）在三个不同评估基准（Mathverse、MMLU、Physics）上的准确率表现。图表的垂直轴（Y轴）表示“Accuracy (%)”，刻度从50到62，以2为间隔，采用线性刻度；水平轴（X轴）表示三个评估基准，按“Mathverse”、“MMLU”、“Physics”的顺序从左至右排列。每个基准下包含五个柱状图，分别对应五种方法，其颜色和图案由图例定义：DAPO+Self-reflection为实心蓝色，DAPO为斜线蓝色，GRPO为斜线橙色，PPO+Self-reflection为实心绿色，PPO为斜线绿色。在“Mathverse”基准下，DAPO+Self-reflection（约56.1%）和PPO+Self-reflection（约54.1%）的柱状图高度相近，DAPO（约53.0%）和GRPO（约53.8%）高度相近且略低于前者，PPO（约53.4%）高度略高于DAPO但低于GRPO；在“MMLU”基准下，DAPO+Self-reflection（约57.0%）和GRPO（约56.0%）高度相近且最高，DAPO（约56.0%）略低于前者，PPO+Self-reflection（约56.2%）略高于DAPO，PPO（约54.3%）最低；在“Physics”基准下，DAPO+Self-reflection（约61.5%）和SRPO（约60.8%）高度相近且最高，DAPO（约57.8%）和GRPO（约58.0%）高度相近且略低于前者，PPO+Self-reflection（约57.5%）略低于DAPO和GRPO，PPO（约57.0%）最低。柱状图按方法类别分组排列，每组内柱状图按图例顺序从左至右排列，无特定排序方式，所有柱状图均无视觉强调。
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for five different models—DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (light blue with diagonal stripes), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (green with diagonal stripes)—across three distinct datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 50 to 62 in increments of 0.5, using a linear scale, and measures the performance of each model. The horizontal x-axis lists the three datasets in order from left to right. For each dataset, five bars are grouped together, each representing one model, with the bars colored and patterned according to the legend. In the Mathverse dataset, the DAPO+Self-reflection model achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56.2%, followed by GRPO at around 53.8%, PPO+Self-reflection at about 53.7%, DAPO at roughly 52.8%, and PPO at approximately 53.0%. In the MMLU dataset, DAPO+Self-reflection again leads at about 56.7%, followed by GRPO at approximately 55.9%, PPO+Self-reflection at around 56.1%, DAPO at roughly 55.9%, and PPO at approximately 54.3%. In the Physics dataset, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 61.5%, followed by GRPO at around 58.2%, PPO+Self-reflection at approximately 59.1%, DAPO at roughly 57.7%, and PPO at approximately 56.5%. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order specified by the legend, with the tallest bars indicating the highest accuracy for each dataset.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Genauigkeit in Prozent für fünf verschiedene Modelle – DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection und PPO – auf drei unterschiedlichen Aufgabenbereichen: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die vertikale Achse stellt die Genauigkeit in Prozent dar, wobei der Wertebereich von 50 bis 62 Prozent reicht und die Achse mit einer linearen Skala und einem Tick-Intervall von zwei Prozent beschriftet ist. Die horizontale Achse listet die drei Aufgabenbereiche in der Reihenfolge Mathverse, MMLU und Physics auf. Jeder Aufgabenbereich ist durch eine Gruppe von fünf farblich und texturierter Balken dargestellt, wobei die Legende oben rechts die Zuordnung der Farben und Muster zu den jeweiligen Modellen angibt: blau mit diagonalen Streifen für DAPO+Self-reflection, hellblau mit diagonalen Streifen für DAPO, orange mit diagonalen Streifen für GRPO, grün mit diagonalen Streifen für PPO+Self-reflection und grün mit diagonalen Streifen für PPO. In jedem Bereich sind die Balken in der Reihenfolge der Modellnamen angeordnet, wobei die Balken für DAPO+Self-reflection und PPO+Self-reflection in den meisten Fällen die höchsten Werte aufweisen. Die Balken sind nicht sortiert, sondern nach der Reihenfolge der Legende gruppiert. Es gibt keine visuelle Hervorhebung einzelner Balken, wie Schattierung oder Fettgedruckt.
